meta: Ten minutes of rambling on a livestream, and viewers come and go. Mark asks AI to plan first: a five-part outline, opening lines, answers to common questions, then his own voice.

muc.title: A rambling livestream
muc.text: Mark tries a livestream to sell scarves, rambles for ten minutes, and viewers keep coming in and leaving.

muc.title: Ask AI for an outline
muc.text: Bit suggests: ask AI for an outline first. A hook to grab attention, the product, the offer, answers to common questions, then closing the sale.

muc.title: An opening that keeps people
muc.text: For short videos, the first three seconds decide whether people scroll past. Ask AI for five opening lines, then pick the one that fits you best.

muc.title: Prepare your answers
muc.text: Ask AI to list ten questions customers often ask about the product, with short answers. When a tough question comes up on air, you're ready.

muc.title: Say it your own way
muc.text: Don't read the script word for word. Customers buy because they like you, so rewrite it the way you naturally talk.

muc.title: An outline for next time
muc.text: Before your next livestream, ask AI for a five-part outline and five opening lines, print them and stick them next to your phone.
